items.title: Make vaultfront.io the explicit staged Cloudflare production origin
items.why: Live DNS proves vaultfront.io still delegates to dns1/dns2.registrar-servers.com, the apex resolves to Namecheap parking 192.64.119.175, and www points to parkingpage.namecheap.com. The GitHub repository currently has zero Actions variables and zero Actions secrets, while deploy/promote workflows require DOMAIN, DEPLOY_INGRESS_PORT, server host/user, GHCR credentials, DATABASE_URL, Cloudflare, Turnstile, and SSH inputs. A purchased domain and READY Cloudflare gateway credentials therefore cannot produce a live game until the edge/origin contract is explicit and the provider configuration is provisioned.
items.recipe: Define vaultfront.io as the canonical production origin and staging.vaultfront.io as the staging origin; update public API/server metadata and release defaults without changing VaultSpark brand links; provision the Cloudflare zone and edge records through gateway credentials; configure bounded GitHub Actions variables/secrets via stdin from getSecret(); execute staging and exact-digest promotion; verify health, revision, TLS, headers, redirects, agent files, and rollback evidence. If Namecheap remains authoritative, leave Cloudflare fully ready and surface only the exact nameserver delegation. Core-loop step: acquisition input -> immediate commander fantasy -> first match reward -> return progression.

L1.recipe: Make vaultfront.io/staging.vaultfront.io canonical in checked-in release metadata and add a drift contract.

L2.recipe: Provision Cloudflare zone/records and repository variables/secrets from the Studio gateway without printing values.

L3.recipe: Deploy staging, attest exact digest, promote production, verify live edge/runtime/rollback evidence, and produce the minimal Namecheap handoff only if delegation remains external.

items.title: Make Radial Menu keyboard focus understandable without vision
items.why: RadialMenu now has menu/menuitem roles, labels, roving tabindex, and keyboard activation, but it has no aria-live status and no keyboard-only Playwright proof. SVG focus moves among slices while the visual tooltip remains the only rich explanation of the hovered action, so screen-reader users cannot reliably hear the current action, availability, or nested-menu position.
items.recipe: Add one visually hidden polite live region owned by RadialMenu; announce the focused item's resolved label plus disabled/submenu state on keyboard movement without duplicating pointer noise; clear it on hide/dispose; and add a keyboard-only Playwright state that opens, traverses, enters a submenu, activates, and verifies the announcement on desktop and mobile-emulated input. Core-loop step: command input -> legible tactical choice fantasy -> successful action reward -> confident continued play.

L1.recipe: Announce resolved focused-item labels in one polite live region.

L2.recipe: Include disabled/submenu position semantics and lifecycle cleanup with focused unit tests.

L3.recipe: Keyboard-only desktop/mobile Playwright proof across open, traverse, submenu, activation, and close.
